_readme: Every relic in the game. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. RELICS ARE DRAFTED PER RUN: three are offered at the start of a descent, the player keeps one for that run only, and it is gone when the run ends — nothing here is permanent progression. The exception is a relic with draftable: false (kinship), which is never offered in a draft or the shop and only arrives through an event's relic effect, still for that run only; its rarity sets only its colour band. rarity is an AUTHORED statement about how often the relic should be offered — unlike item rarity it is not derived from a tier, because a relic has no numbers to derive it from; changing a relic's band is this one word and nothing else. OMIT effect for a relic that has no mechanic yet — it resolves to None, which is exempt from the one-relic-per-effect rule precisely so a pool of named-but-unimplemented relics can exist. Every other effect must still be unique: two relics doing the same thing makes one of them a dead choice in a draft. Field-by-field documentation, defaults and valid enum values: docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md.
_placeholders: forest_wardens_tooth is DELIBERATELY MECHANIC-LESS -- it exists so the draft, the rarity ladder and the glossary can be seen working against a pool big enough to be a real choice, before anybody has designed what it does. It is the only one left; every other relic that used to sit in this state (seven_teeth through drowned_lantern) has since earned an `effect`. Give it one when it earns one; until then it is honest about being furniture. Of the 20 relics from balance pass 2 (magic_marker through phoenix_egg), loaded_dice and dancers_anklet still point iconPath at Assets/_Project/Art/Generated/disc_metal.png -- a baked metallic-coin placeholder (see ProceduralSpriteBaker) -- until each earns real art from Art/Items/Relics/Processed/; the other eighteen already have it. None of the 20 are mechanic-less, only unillustrated.

relics.description: Each attack you make strikes the same target a second time.
After you cast a spell, gain a 20-point **ward** that lasts the rest of the fight.
The first time you kill an enemy each fight, take another turn.
Each kill pays gold equal to 30% of its XP (minimum 1).
Each attack you land reduces all your cooldowns by 1.
Gain up to +30% damage and +20% speed. Maximum bonus reached at 25% HP or below.
Casting a spell gives +20% speed for your next turn.
Each attack you land gives +10% speed for the rest of the fight. Maximum +40%.
Every third attack you land each fight deals 40% more damage.
A spell that lands **Marks** its target. Your next attack on a Marked target deals 50% more damage.
Taken from the thing that guards the first wood. It has no power yet.
+20% attack, -10% defense.
+40 max HP, -5% speed.
Every fourth spell you cast each fight deals 50% more damage.
+25 physical resistance and +25 magical resistance.
Each spell that lands on an enemy is followed by a free basic attack on it.
Each attack you land rolls at random: heal 5% HP and 10% mana, deal 25% of the damage to every other enemy, or slow the target by 30% for 1 turn.
Each single-target damaging spell you cast repeats once on the same target, free.
Your spells **Mark** the enemy they hit. Attacking a Marked enemy consumes the Mark and restores 20% of your missing mana (or signature resource).
**Marks** every enemy when combat begins.
When you drop below 30% HP, every enemy is **Feared** for 1 turn. Re-arms when you climb back above 30%.
Damaging an enemy lowers its resistances by 3% for 3 turns. Stacks up to 15%.
Each enemy you kill (summons excluded) gives +2% damage for the rest of the run.

relics.description: {physical} damage gains 35 flat armor penetration.
After you cast a convergence ability, take 50% less damage for 1 turn.
Each attack slows the target by 10%. Stacks up to 40%. Each stack lasts 5 turns.
At the start of the fight, **stun** one random enemy for 1 turn.
Your melee attacks can reach any enemy, whatever its position.
Super-effective hits deal an extra 20% damage.
Moving gives +30% speed for 1 turn.
Any action of yours that changes a position on the field gives a 10-point **ward**, once per turn.
When an enemy dies (summons excluded), heal 3% of your max HP.
Whenever an enemy summons a unit, the summoner takes damage equal to your max HP.
Once per combat, an enemy you kill strikes one of its former allies once before it is gone.
After you attack, cast a spell or use an ability, move one position forward in the turn order.
Getting hit reduces all your cooldowns by 1, once per turn.
Heal for 10% of the damage your attacks deal.
Fatal damage turns you into an egg for 3 turns with HP equal to your max HP. Revive with the fraction that survives, or die if it breaks. Once per combat.
The first hit Shawn takes each fight is negated.
Each transformation Shawn enters lasts 1 turn longer.
Every third turn Shawn takes, every enemy takes damage equal to 15% of his attack, x1.5 while he is transformed.
